quest: P-004 causal pressure/shock phase-front timing challenger
hypothesis: Prior-only nonordinary SPY volume/range pressure identifies when an XSP reversal front deserves attention, but direction and timing become authoritative only when the existing strictly causal XSP phase-front candidate propagates and both SPY and XSP accept that same direction. This may identify serious pressure/shock pivots earlier than the future-aware landmark confirmation while retaining every false alarm.

pre_outcome_evidence.observation: The three-scale-stable oracle contains 200 RTH pressure/shock landmarks. Existing causal phase fronts match 143; 94 land early, 37 at the same close, and 12 late. Opening landmarks are an explicit contrast: only 47 of 446 match and 45 are late.
pre_outcome_evidence.exposure: Counts, class identity, and causal landing timestamps only. No future prices, return, MFE, MAE, PnL, drawdown, trade outcome, or selected action was exposed.

windows.visibility: All periods may expose identity, readiness, counts, categorical phase shapes, emission timestamps, and future-aware landmark matches. Prices after an emission and all economics remain sealed until the count gate passes.

causal_law.session_reset: phase, pressure, incumbent, candidate, and one-emission ownership reset at every RTH session or causal tape gap

pressure.ordinary: neither joint rank reaches 0.80 and neither one-sided rank reaches 0.95
pressure.one_sided: volume or normalized true-range rank reaches 0.95 without joint confirmation

causal_law.direction: The existing XspPhaseFrontEngine candidate_direction is the sole candidate direction. Pressure magnitude, bar body, future landmark direction, and crown outcome may not create or reverse it.

cross_instrument_acceptance.full_acceptance: For the candidate direction, both current XSP and SPY close-to-close returns are positive, each instrument has at least three of five aligned slopes, and each has at least three of five aligned slope velocities.
cross_instrument_acceptance.refusal: Either current return is opposite or either instrument has at least three of five slopes and velocities opposite the candidate direction.
cross_instrument_acceptance.underwarmed: Any missing current return, slope, velocity, rank, or required clock; never synthesize it.

emission.required_pressure: ONE_SIDED, ELEVATED, or SHOCK on the same completed close
emission.deduplication: Emit the first eligible state once per uninterrupted candidate wave and direction. Do not re-emit until RELAPSED, PIVOT_ACCEPTED, an opposite candidate, a gap, or the RTH terminal closes that wave.
emission.output: one immutable morphology emission with no action, permission, sizing, lifecycle, execution, order, or capital authority

false_alarm_completeness: every eligible causal emission, whether or not a future serious landmark exists
every nonordinary-pressure observation with no emission
every nonordinary-pressure candidate wave that relapses
every emission unmatched to the three-scale-stable pressure/shock oracle
every underwarmed, gap-reset, partial-transport, and refused-transport state
causal_law.oracle_join: Evaluation only: greedy one-to-one same RTH date and direction. An emission may match a three-scale-stable PRESSURE_PIVOT or SHOCK_HANDOFF_PIVOT only when it occurs from the landmark extreme through its terminal. Timing is EARLY, SAME_CLOSE, or LATE versus immutable causal_confirmation_utc. Oracle membership never enters the causal law.

next_stage_law.on_count_pass: Freeze exactly one economic replay law before opening prices: compare timing-only cooperation with v3 against a complementary pressure-pivot sleeve, preserve all attribution, and select on Years 1 and 2 before one locked Year 3 challenge.
next_stage_law.on_count_fail: Reject P-004 count-only. Do not lower rank, breadth, transport, phase, direction, or control gates after seeing counts.
next_stage_law.crown_gate: Any successor must exceed 200 trades per year and improve PnL/drawdown by at least 5 percent in most available one-year periods, with both directions and ordinary, choppy, pressure, shock, crash, rebound, and upside-spike stability.
